scope: Fortnite iCalendar feeds for Apple Calendar and RFC 5545 clients

write_policy.before_write: Construct complete logical VEVENT data first, then serialize with CRLF and RFC 5545 folding. Never fold by character count; fold by UTF-8 octets without splitting a code point.
write_policy.after_write: The GitHub Actions validator must pass. A failed validation is a technical regression and must be corrected before additional calendar content changes.
write_policy.sequence_rule: Formatting-only normalization never increments VEVENT SEQUENCE. SEQUENCE changes only for real event/business-data changes.
write_policy.sync_rule: An event mirrored in global and specialist feeds must be byte-semantically identical after unfolding, including UID, DTSTAMP, LAST-MODIFIED, SEQUENCE, VALARM and X-FORTNITE fields.

git_line_endings.reason: Prevent Git from silently converting CRLF serialization to LF.
